|quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} {{status | name = Lifetap | type = Buff | description = Your flasks recover increased amounts of life. }} '''Lifetap Support''' is a [[support gem]] that causes linked skills to have a [[life]] [[cost]] instead of a [[mana]] cost, similar to the [[Blood Magic]] keystone, at the expense of a high cost multiplier. Spending a certain amount of life grants the Lifetap buff, which allows skills supported by Lifetap to deal more damage. For the support gem that changes mana [[reservation]]s to life, see {{il|Arrogance Support}}. ==Skill functions and interactions== {{c|mod|Supported Skills Cost Life instead of Mana}}: * This is not a [[conversion]] mechanic: the cost will no longer be affected by modifiers specific for mana costs. * Additional base mana costs (e.g. [[Divine Blessing Support]], [[The_Lake_of_Kalandra#Reflecting_Mist|Inverted]] [[Elreon, Light's Judge|Elreon's]]) do add to life cost. {{c|mod|Gain Lifetap after Spending a total of # Life with a Supported Skill}}: * The buff grants {{c|mod|20% increased Life Recovery from Flasks}} and has a duration of 4 seconds. * Because the buff has a duration, supported skills will become supportable by supports like {{il|Less Duration Support}} and {{il|Swift Affliction Support}}. This does ''not'' add a duration [[gem tag]];https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/bv0j8g/questions_thread_may_31_2019/eq19c1c/?context=2 supported skills will not be affected by modifiers like {{c|mod|+# to Level of Socketed Duration Gems}}. * The player may choose to use a lower level Lifetap gem to gain the buff after less life spent. {{c|mod|Supported Skills deal (10-19)% more Damage while you have Lifetap}} * This stat's condition can be met by having any Lifetap buff, even from other skills. It is not part of the buff and does not scale with buff effect. Its combination of properties can make Lifetap an interesting option for skills with otherwise lacking support options. For example: :{{sl|Death Aura}} has no mana cost and no duration. Supporting it with Lifetap will give it a duration, and allow it to be supported by {{il|Swift Affliction Support}}. The skill cannot actually grant Lifetap because it can't spend life, so instead, a second (level 1) Lifetap Support is linked to one or more other skills, like {{il|Withering Step}} or {{il|Phase Run}}. Death Aura now has two ''more damage'' multipliers from supports it normally can't use. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = more Damage |c1_header = Supported Skills deal x% more Damage while you have Lifetap |c1_pattern_extract = Supported Skills deal (%d+)%% more Damage while you have Lifetap |c1_pattern_value = %d%% |c2_abbr = Gain Buff
Life Cost |c2_header = Gain Lifetap after Spending a total of x Life on Upfront Costs and Effects of a Supported Skill |c2_pattern_extract = Gain Lifetap after Spending a total of (%d+) Life on Upfront |c2_pattern_value = %d }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Related modifiers== {{Query spawnable modifiers |where=granted_skill = "SupportLifetap" |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type = 1 }} ==Unique items== {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where= items.stat_text LIKE "%random Support Gem%" OR items.stat_text LIKE "%Supported by%Lifetap%" OR items.name = "The Hungry Loop" |level=1 |stat=1 |large=1 }} Moreover, {{il|Replica Forbidden Shako}}, which is drop disabled, also grants this support gem. ==See also== * {{il|Inspiration Support}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Quality now causes Lifetap to last +0-2 seconds, instead of causing Supported Skills to deal 0-10% increased Damage. }} {{Version history table row|3.19.0| * Blessing Skills can no longer be supported by Lifetap. }} {{Version history table row|3.15.0| * Now has a 300% Cost and Reservation Multiplier (previously 200%). * Supported Skills now deal 10-19% more Damage while you have Lifetap (previously 10-29%). * Now Gain Lifetap after Spending a total of 23-273 Life with a Supported Skill (previously 17-205). }} {{Version history table row|3.14.0| * Blood Magic Support has been removed. Two new Support gems have been added in its place: [[Arrogance Support]] and '''Lifetap Support'''. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Navbox Support Gems}} {{sister|poe2wiki=Lifetap}}
